reviews.text: The importance of the owner's commitment stems from the fundamental principle that "dogs live life to the fullest." This is backed by past experience and includes assessments of the dog's personality, advice tailored to that personality, and practical training. What surprised me most was how much calmer my dog ​​became the very next day. I had some expectations, but the content and results far exceeded them. I'm so glad I received training from Mr. Nakajima.

I had my Yorkshire Terrier, who is almost two years old, examined.

Since my child was born, his demanding barking has gradually worsened, and he has become sensitive to outside noises as well as the doorbell, which was causing me a lot of trouble.

Within a few hours, he got used to the doorbell, and although he still barks sometimes, he is much calmer than before. I was surprised at how quickly he changed.

Like the MBTI assessment for humans, I was also told about my dog's personality and type, and there were many things that made sense, like why he was behaving the way he did, and I feel like I understand his feelings better than before.

I feel like things have become easier for both of us since I had this consultation. I'm so glad I did.

I received training assistance for my 9-month-old Shiba Inu. This is my first time owning a Japanese breed, and I've been overwhelmed by many things. Since my family and I couldn't solve everything on our own, I researched various options and found Dr. Nakajima.

My first visit was when he was 6 months old. He was beyond mischievous and had become uncontrollable in many ways, but it turned out the problem was more with the owner than the dog. Following Dr. Nakajima's guidance on diet, walks, playtime, and sleep, things improved within a few days.

Later, as he grew, new problems arose, and I received guidance again today.

It seems my lack of consistency as the owner had negatively impacted my dog, making him quite bossy. Dr. Nakajima assured me that it's still possible to correct things little by little, and I feel much more positive about starting today.

I will keep in mind that being firm in response to aggression is not abuse but self-defense, and I will not back down. I will firmly and firmly tell him what is unacceptable, and I will raise him with love and without spoiling him.

These two valuable sessions with Dr. Nakajima have given me such valuable insights.

Next time, I'd like to ask for your guidance on walking my dog, which is another area where the owner has some issues.

Even though it's a problematic area, I'm somehow looking forward to it, perhaps because of your personality.

Thank you very much in advance.

We received excellent care for our 5-month-old Australian Labradoodle.

As this was our first time living with a dog, my husband and I were unsure how to interact with a puppy or how to play with him. We were at a loss, but meeting the trainer helped us gradually understand how to interact with our dog. The initial consultation, which included both human and dog counseling, was incredibly helpful and thorough.

The trainer carefully assessed our dog's temperament, explaining what he was suited for and what we should do.

I was surprised that the walking speed was faster than I had anticipated.

He used to eat things off the ground a lot, which was a real problem, but the trainer taught us the secrets to pre-walk care, and it gradually decreased. Now he hardly does it anymore.

We recently had the opportunity to meet again, and he gave us a chiropractic treatment. He pointed out areas of misalignment and stiffness, and taught us massage points that are useful for everyday communication. I would definitely like to request another chiropractic treatment.

We are both comfortable and happy with the time we spend together.

We are filled with gratitude for all the help we have received. Thank you very much.

We look forward to your continued support.

Our resident dog had been barking constantly since we welcomed two new puppies into our home.

We tried letting them meet for 5 minutes each day to help them get used to each other, but the stress caused persistent diarrhea...

We felt so sorry for them, so we kept them in separate living spaces within the house, but we knew that if they didn't get used to each other gradually, it would be very difficult in the future... We were really worried about what to do, but then Ms. Nakajima came over, and just by slightly changing how we held and introduced the puppies, they were able to pass by the puppies without barking!!

We were so surprised and happy...it really felt like a miracle!

The puppies also immediately allowed us to hold them on their backs as she taught us, and the effect was amazing after just one visit.

Furthermore, Ms. Nakajima also has qualifications in psychology, and she listened to us very carefully, naturally drawing out worries that we hadn't even been able to sort out ourselves.

Not only was it beneficial for the dogs, but it also made me, the owner, feel so much more at ease.

I'm so glad we asked for her help!

If I have any problems in the future, I would definitely like to ask Ms. Nakajima for help again.

To pet owners who are struggling alone: ​​It's much faster to have Ms. Nakajima take a look and teach you the correct way to do things before continuing with those actions! And it's immediately effective! She's a truly excellent trainer!

Thank you so much!

My dog ​​is 8 years old and in his senior years. I never imagined he would become so well-behaved in just one day! By deepening our bond of trust, his excessive barking has improved by 90%.
He still barks once when the doorbell rings, but that's just part of his charm.
He's also much calmer now that his workload has decreased. He was calm and didn't bark at all during our recent family trip.
I'm so grateful! Thank you so much!

[July 2026 Update]
We were delighted to have you visit us again after six months. The issue of our son's unruly behavior during elevator rides, which was previously impossible, has improved. I was pleased to receive praise for the progress, and also to receive advice for the next step.

You taught us so much again this time, including how to handle the step-up tummy-showing and how to interact with our son, and I hope to use this to further improve things.

Although we went considerably over the scheduled time, I am very grateful that you listened to us so attentively.

I will definitely consult with you again if anything comes up in the future!

I am changing my rating from ★4 to ★5.

(Below is the original text from six months ago)

My son couldn't even be held at home, so I was incredibly moved and happy when he was able to show his belly. I hope to cherish my paternal instincts and build a more intimate and secure relationship with him. Thank you very much.

Here, they don't teach you how to teach your dog tricks, but rather the fundamental relationship between dogs and humans, the nature of each dog, and how to train them effectively, step by step. Personally, I think this is what every dog ​​owner should know first. I wish I had taken this course sooner. The only downside is the price. Thank you so much.

I'm truly amazed by the difference after just one day.

Our Chihuahua barks incessantly at people. His bark is loud and shrill, so as summer approaches, even with the windows open, it's bothering our neighbors. I was really worried about this when I learned about Ms. Nakajima and asked for her help. What's amazing is that it's not a reward-based training method (we're currently on a diet, so we didn't want to give him treats). And it's not a method that uses loud noises to startle him.

She quietly and thoughtfully explained our dog's physical condition, personality, and what he needed, teaching us a training method that allows both dog and owner to coexist without stress. It was truly wonderful. When she first came to visit, our dog was barking so much that we couldn't even hear what she was saying, but the way she held him stopped the barking completely. I was so moved I almost cried. Since then, the training sessions have been a series of amazing discoveries. We'll be living together for a long time to come, and I'm so grateful to have met Ms. Nakajima and to have received her training. Thank you so much.

I contacted them because I was worried about my 4-year-old dog's barking. I had used another service once before, but this one was incomparably more thorough, starting with a careful consultation and a health check of the dog. They considered the cause of my problem from every angle, and I learned about my dog's personality and the unspoken emotional and physical issues. The training methods were taught step by step and demonstrated many times, making it easy to understand. I was especially moved to tears when they specifically taught me how to stop my dog's excessive barking at people other than me in the house, which I had been unable to do anything about, in just one day. This was a huge difference from the previous time I was taught methods that didn't address the root cause of the barking, such as distracting the dog with treats. I also worried that it might be too late to train a 4-year-old, but the training was not at all deceptive, forceful, or intimidating, and it was done with the dog's feelings in mind, so it wasn't a matter of early or late, and it made me realize that dogs can understand anything as long as the direction is right, no matter how old they are. We were able to re-evaluate our mindset and our feelings towards our dog, and we now have a much better understanding of how to deal with his barking.

They also kindly discussed future plans while monitoring our dog's training progress. Since our dog has some physical misalignment, we also requested a chiropractic adjustment at the end. The entire 3-hour training session was very satisfying. I truly feel fortunate to have found such a trustworthy and excellent trainer.
